diagnosis: Customer asks about billing for mid-cycle seat additions. Account is on Startup plan with 5 seats, no upgrade or plan change involved. Knowledge base indicates seat additions are billed pro rata from the day of addition.
reply: When you add seats mid-month, you are not charged for the full month. Instead, the charge is prorated from the date the seats are added through the end of your current billing cycle. For example, if you add 4 seats next week, the cost will be calculated only for the remaining days in that month. You can refer to our article on seat count changes and billing impact for more details.
